title: Codex goal mode, Appshots, locked computer use
summary: Goal mode leaves beta so Codex can drive toward an objective for hours or days; Appshots send any Mac window to Codex; computer use keeps working after your Mac locks.
plans: Codex app, IDE and CLI users

title: Workspace agents generally available
summary: Shared team agents built by describing a workflow. They run on Codex in the cloud, on a schedule or from Slack, across Gmail, Drive, Salesforce and more, with approval gates and audit logs.
plans: Business, Enterprise, Edu (research preview since Apr 22)

title: Claude Opus 4.8
summary: Upgraded Opus with gains over Opus 4.7 in coding, agentic skills, reasoning and practical knowledge work.
plans: Claude apps and API (plan detail not stated in release note)

title: Dynamic workflows: hundreds of parallel subagents
summary: Claude Code can write its own orchestration script and run tens to hundreds of subagents in parallel for big jobs, checking the work before it reaches you.
plans: Claude Code (generally available)

title: GPT-5.5 Instant update; o3 and GPT-4.5 retiring
summary: GPT-5.5 Instant gets a more natural, less bullet-heavy style and loses canvas; o3 and GPT-4.5 are scheduled to leave ChatGPT.
plans: ChatGPT and API; retirements are ChatGPT-only

title: Codex computer use and remote control on Windows
summary: Codex can operate Windows desktop apps by seeing, clicking and typing, and Windows machines can be driven remotely from the ChatGPT phone app.
plans: Codex app on Windows

title: Codex plugins for every role, plus Sites
summary: Role plugins bundle apps, skills and workflows for non-developers, including public equity investing and investment banking (PitchBook, FactSet, Datasite). Private equity is next. Plus Sites and annotations.
plans: Plugins: Codex, supported regions; Sites: Business and Enterprise preview (admin-enabled)

title: ChatGPT memory that stays up to date
summary: Memory now updates itself automatically, drops stale or contradictory facts, and doubles capacity for paid users; old saved-memories mode stays available.
plans: Plus and Pro in the US first; Free/Go and other countries later

title: Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5
summary: New Mythos-class tier above Opus. Fable 5 is for general use; Mythos 5 is limited to vetted partners. Access was paused June 12 and restored July 1.
plans: Pro, Max, Team, seat Enterprise free until Jun 22, then usage credits; full on API

title: Simplified ChatGPT model picker
summary: Picker becomes Instant, Medium, High, Extra High plus Pro options, replacing the Thinking Light/Standard/Extended/Heavy labels.
plans: Plus and Pro

title: Edit Claude's drafts in place
summary: Drafts open beside the chat; highlight a passage, type the change, and Claude edits exactly that spot instead of rewriting the whole thing.
plans: Chat and Cowork

title: Scheduled tasks page replaces Pulse
summary: A Scheduled page manages reminders, recurring work and monitoring tasks that check the web and connected apps; Pulse is sunset in favor of tasks.
plans: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise

title: Claude Code publishes live, shareable artifacts
summary: Claude Code turns a session into a live web page (PR walkthrough, dashboard, incident timeline) that updates in place and is shared inside your org.
plans: Team and Enterprise (beta), CLI and desktop

title: Record & Replay turns demos into skills
summary: On Mac, show Codex a workflow once and it saves it as a reusable skill; threads can also hand off between local and remote machines.
plans: Codex app on macOS; not EEA/UK/CH at launch (added Jul 31)

title: Claude Tag: delegate to Claude in Slack
summary: Tag Claude in a Slack conversation and hand it a task to work on while the team keeps going.
plans: Team and Enterprise

title: Codex Remote GA: run Codex from your phone
summary: Start, monitor and approve Codex work on your Mac or Windows machine from the ChatGPT mobile app. Out of a preview that began May 14.
plans: ChatGPT mobile app with Codex, all plans incl. Free and Go

title: Claude Sonnet 5
summary: Most agentic Sonnet yet, with big gains over Sonnet 4.6 in reasoning, tool use, coding and knowledge work.
plans: All plans; default for Free and Pro

title: Cowork on web and mobile; M365 write access
summary: Cowork runs in the cloud and follows you to web and phone; the Microsoft 365 connector can now send email, manage calendar and edit OneDrive/SharePoint files.
plans: Cowork: Max first, then other plans; M365 write tools need Entra and org admin consent

title: GPT-Live-1 powers ChatGPT Voice
summary: New voice model that listens and speaks at the same time, so interruptions feel natural; can search the web and use memory.
plans: Consumer plans incl. Free (mini); not Business/Enterprise/Edu at launch

title: ChatGPT Work and the new desktop app
summary: ChatGPT Work: an agent that stays with a project for hours across your apps and hands back sheets, slides, docs or web apps. Codex merges into one new desktop app with Chat and Work.
plans: Work: Pro, Enterprise, Edu first, then Plus and Business; desktop app with Chat, Work and Codex on every plan incl. Free

title: ChatGPT Sites public beta; Atlas retired
summary: Turn work into a shareable website or lightweight app with a public URL. Same day OpenAI retired group chats and set Atlas browser shutdown for Aug 9.
plans: Sites: Business, Enterprise (admin), Pro, Edu, then Plus

title: GPT-5.6 Sol
summary: OpenAI's flagship reasoning model for coding, research, computer use and design starts rolling out in ChatGPT.
plans: Eligible paid plans; not Free, Go or logged-out

title: Claude memory rebuilt as editable entries
summary: Memory becomes individual, categorized entries Claude reads and updates mid-conversation, replacing the old once-a-day memory summary.
plans: Plans with memory (Free, Pro, Max; Team/Enterprise if owner allows)

title: Claude Opus 5
summary: Close to Fable 5 intelligence at half the price, built for long-running agents, coding and professional work.
plans: Default on Max; available on Pro

title: Auto mode becomes Claude Code default
summary: A safety classifier approves routine actions and blocks risky ones, so Claude Code asks permission less and runs longer on its own.
plans: Pro, Max, Ultra, Team (Enterprise opt-in)

title: Import from Claude Code, Cowork and Cursor
summary: ChatGPT desktop app imports instructions, skills, plugins, projects and recent work from Claude Code, Claude Cowork and Cursor, and can keep them synced; Linux preview too.
plans: ChatGPT desktop app (Codex)

title: Ultrafast: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14× speed
summary: A new API service tier running on Cerebras chips, up to 750 output tokens per second. By the Nov 17 GPT-6.2 launch, Pro subscribers could use Ultrafast in ChatGPT.
plans: API, limited preview first; later ChatGPT Pro (Pro 500 with Astra and Sol, Pro 200 with Sol)

title: New artifact sharing: open without an account
summary: Artifacts get one Share menu: private by default, 'anyone with the link' pages open without a Claude account, view/comment/edit levels, email invites (beta).
plans: Link sharing Pro and up; Team/Enterprise need owner to allow external sharing

title: One memory across chat and Cowork
summary: Memory carries between chats and cloud Cowork tasks; everything remembered is an editable Topics list; health, beliefs and similar stay out unless you opt in.
plans: On by default Free/Pro/Max/Ultra; Team/Enterprise owner-controlled

title: Claude in Chrome generally available
summary: Browser extension that reads, clicks and navigates sites for you, with a per-action safety check; Enterprise admins can limit it to approved domains.
plans: All paid plans (Chrome only)

title: GPT-6 Astra
summary: OpenAI's top model for professional work: computer use across everyday apps, firm templates, financial statements. First model to reach OpenAI's Critical cybersecurity threshold, so it ships with tighter safeguards.
plans: ChatGPT Work, Codex, API ($10/$50 per million tokens); off by default for Enterprise until an admin enables it

title: SharePoint, Box, Dropbox in ChatGPT Library
summary: Point ChatGPT at SharePoint, Box or Dropbox folders without re-uploading; existing file permissions apply.
plans: Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, Healthcare, Enterprise (web)

title: ChatGPT for Financial Services
summary: ChatGPT Work with financial data built in (PitchBook, Crunchbase, Preqin, FactSet, S&P Capital IQ, Datasite and more) on GPT-6 Astra. Builds models, research notes and pitchbooks in your firm's templates.
plans: Eligible financial institutions, via sales; Enterprise controls, information barriers, compliance log export

title: Agents API: the Codex harness for developers
summary: Developers build cloud agents on the machinery behind Codex and ChatGPT Work: a hosted sandbox, sessions lasting hours or days, subagents, MCP and tool search. No extra fee beyond tokens and tools.
plans: API, public beta for all developers

title: Custom GPTs to be retired
summary: OpenAI announced custom GPTs will be retired and migrated to plugins; new GPT creation was switched off for affected Enterprise workspaces on Oct 26.
plans: All ChatGPT plans (dates vary)

title: Cowork and chat become one Claude
summary: No mode switch: ask a quick question or hand over a report, spreadsheet or deck, and Claude works on it in the cloud even after you close the laptop.
plans: Pro and Max rolling out; Enterprise GA Oct 23 (admin toggle)

title: Designs, decks and docs in any chat
summary: Claude Design, Claude Slides and Claude Docs (living, shared documents) can be created and edited from any conversation. Artifacts are rebuilt: ones made in chat before Sep 16 become legacy, still working and shareable.
plans: Every plan incl. Free; beta on Enterprise until Oct 8

title: ChatGPT for Word
summary: A ChatGPT sidebar in Microsoft Word drafts from notes, summarizes and revises selected text, joining the Excel and PowerPoint add-ins.
plans: All plans incl. Free

title: Claude Opus 5.5
summary: Performs at Fable 5.1 level on most work at 40% lower cost than Opus 5; becomes the default model in the Claude apps.
plans: Default on Pro, Max, Ultra, Team

title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna in Work and Codex
summary: Sol for complex agentic work and Luna for high-volume tasks, cheaper than GPT-5.6; Work/Codex models are now separate from Chat models.
plans: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise (admin), Edu; Luna for Free/Go on desktop

title: Plugins bundle connectors and skills
summary: Plugins package MCP connectors with Agent Skills into one installable unit; developers submit them to the Claude directory through a new portal.
plans: Claude directory (all plans with plugins)

title: Claude Sonnet 5.5
summary: Faster, cheaper companion to Opus 5.5: 30%+ faster and up to 30% cheaper than Sonnet 5.
plans: Claude apps, Claude Code, API

title: Dots: always-on agents in ChatGPT
summary: Always-on agents with their own cloud computer and browser, 4,000+ connectable apps, and memory that learns how you work. They act on triggers or proactively, under rules you set.
plans: Pro, Business Premium, Enterprise (beta, GA Nov 4; incl. Edu and Healthcare when an admin enables it); first dot included

title: Space, Pages and a Meetings plugin
summary: Shared Pages for co-writing in Space, plus a Mac Meetings plugin that takes notes and action items and deletes the audio.
plans: Meetings: Pro and Business beta (macOS); Enterprise later

title: Codex Cloud
summary: Coding tasks run in isolated cloud workspaces you can start from desktop, web or phone, and keep going while your computer sleeps.
plans: ChatGPT plans with Codex

title: GPT-6.1 Sol
summary: Improves on GPT-6 Sol in agentic coding, computer use and professional work, in ChatGPT Work and Codex.
plans: Pro first, then Plus, Business, Enterprise, Edu

title: Mods: customize Claude Code
summary: Small TypeScript add-ons that change how Claude Code behaves or looks, such as blocking risky commands or adding a status panel; shareable as plugins.
plans: Claude Code

title: Claude in Google Docs, Sheets, Slides
summary: A Google Workspace add-on puts Claude inside open files, and new connectors let Claude create and edit native Google files live beside the chat.
plans: Public beta, all paid plans

title: Claude Haiku 5.5
summary: Cheapest, fastest small Claude model yet, for high-volume, cost-sensitive work.

title: GPT-6 with Intelligent UI in ChatGPT
summary: ChatGPT's new default mixes text with charts, comparisons and small interactive tools, and starts answering while it is still thinking.
plans: Paid plans get Sol; Free and Go get Luna (from Oct 8)

title: Claude Dashboards and Motion; Docs and Slides GA
summary: Live dashboards from your data enter beta; Motion makes animated explainers that export as MP4. Docs, Slides and Design leave beta on every plan.
plans: Dashboards: paid plans; Motion: Team and Enterprise beta; Docs/Slides/Design: all plans

title: Code Review generally available
summary: Claude automatically reviews pull requests to catch bugs before they reach production.

title: ChatGPT Slides
summary: Build decks from a chat, files or outline, co-edit in real time with comments, and export to PowerPoint, PDF or Google Slides.
plans: Pro, Business, Enterprise with Space

title: Claude Duet research preview
summary: Separate app where Claude acts as a proactive agent with a morning brief and background work, asking approval before any send, payment or signature.
plans: US Pro, Max, Ultra (waitlist)

title: GPT-6.1 Terra
summary: Low-cost model for visual reasoning, computer use and writing, in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API ($1/$5 per million tokens).
plans: Work and Codex (not Chat); API

title: One Plugins page for connectors and skills
summary: 'Customize' becomes 'Plugins': one page to find, add and manage plugins, skills and connectors, with quick filters and Verified/Community labels.
plans: Free to Team from Oct 29 (GA Nov 9); Enterprise Nov 30

title: Enterprise security center and shadow-IT blocking
summary: One page compares settings to Anthropic's recommendations; admins can block personal Claude accounts on firm laptops and route prompts through DLP tools.
plans: Claude Enterprise (several parts beta)

title: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
summary: Anthropic's new top models for the hardest technical work; Mythos stays restricted to approved partners.
plans: Fable 5.2 on all paid plans; usage credits on Pro and standard Team/Enterprise seats

title: Claude Sheets, Whiteboards and Data
summary: Sheets built from a prompt, with every change outlined (basic for now; export to .xlsx or CSV). Shared Whiteboards that become a doc or deck. Data leaves beta with certified metrics and live sharing.
plans: All paid plans; Sheets and Whiteboards beta, Data GA. On Enterprise, Sheets and Whiteboards stay off until an admin turns them on

title: Partner apps open inside Claude
summary: Connectors like Adobe, Atlassian, Box and Notion open as full apps beside the conversation, and Claude works inside them with you.
plans: All plans, web and desktop

title: Businesses in ChatGPT and Business Agents
summary: Companies claim and update their ChatGPT listing and see how often they're mentioned; eligible US ecommerce and online services can launch a customer-facing agent, sponsorable as an ad.
plans: Claiming: eligible businesses where ChatGPT is available; Business Agents: eligible US businesses (beta)

title: Claude Meetings (beta)
summary: Claude joins a Google Meet call, takes notes, answers questions and builds docs live; it stays out of calls with outside guests by default.
plans: Team and Enterprise beta; Google Meet only

title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
summary: Astra for the hardest professional work, Sol for everyday tasks at a fifth of the cost. Trained on finance conventions: valuation workbooks, DCFs, investment memos. Astra is 20% cheaper than GPT-6 Astra.
plans: ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Enterprise, Edu; Work, Codex and the API (gpt-6.2-astra, gpt-6.2-sol)

title: ChatGPT for Sales
summary: Sales plugin plus 30+ partner plugins (Salesforce, HubSpot, Attio, Clay, ZoomInfo); a dot can prep account briefs and track deals for review.
plans: Admins enable in Admin Console

title: Dots on by default in Enterprise
summary: Dots switch on by default in eligible Enterprise workspaces unless the admin opted out during the preview.
plans: ChatGPT Enterprise
